subject: On‑prem IaC ownership handover — Helm / Ansible normalization and CI gating
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, irene_choi@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com, Arjun Patel <arjun.patel@acme.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2026-09-20T09:12:00Z
Subject: On‑prem IaC ownership handover — starting the handoff + normalization items

Team / Arjun,

Per our commitment to hand over the on‑prem/VPC IaC ownership to the Platform team, I put together an initial delta list and a proposed normalization plan. Please review the attached dep graph and checklist before our sync next week. High‑level asks: 

- Confirm module interfaces we need to lock (networking, bastion, enclave, registry).
- Approve the CI gating criteria in the checklist (I attached a spreadsheet).
- Call out any customer constraints on maintenance windows or airgap packaging.

Key notes in the attachment: privstack-dep-graph-v2.png (visual of current module DAG) and priv-iac-normalization-diff.patch (patch with interface proposals). I flagged three modules where we recommend replacing inline scripts with Ansible roles and consolidating Helm value schemas.

Proposed meeting: Tue 22 Sep, 11:00–11:45 PT — I created a calendar hold (link in related_links). If that works for Acme, we can finalize ownership matrix and timeline (target: 2026‑10‑15 cutover).

Thanks — short replies welcome if you only have a single item to call out.

— Priyom
Priyom Das
Platform Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, irene_choi@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com, Arjun Patel <arjun.patel@acme.com>
Date: 2026-09-20T13:30:00Z
Subject: Re: On‑prem IaC ownership handover — starting the handoff + normalization items

Priyom — quick read, thanks for the artifacts. A few practical things from the infra side: 

- Module boundary suggestion: collapse the current "edge-provisioners" + "bastion-scripts" into a single network‑bootstrap module with a well‑defined outputs schema (subnet ids, route tables, NATs). That will reduce the dependency fan‑out in day‑2 changes.
- CI: add an initial "bootstrap‑smoke" job that runs in the merge request pipeline against a lightweight emulation (k3s + mock KV) — this catches early Helm schema regressions before full integration tests.
- Secrets: agree with replacing inline cred fetches with a secrets-provider interface; we should standardize on a common lookup role (ansible role: secrets/lookup) and verify in CI via a mocked KMS.

I left inline comments on MR 4123 (gitlab link in related_links). I can pick up the bootstrap job template if you want — will need 2 days to prepare and another day to run a dry run with Acme's network diagram.

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
(attachment: priv-iac-normalization-diff.patch patch)

From: Arjun Patel <arjun.patel@acme.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-21T08:05:00Z
Subject: Re: On‑prem IaC ownership handover — starting the handoff + normalization items

Thanks Priyom, Karthik — this looks reasonable. A couple of items from Acme's side: 

- Maintenance windows: we prefer rolling maintenance windows (2 hours, 02:00–04:00 local) for the enclave updates. Any PRs that touch the egress/BGP pieces will need explicit blackout scheduling in the PR description.
- Secrets/KMS: we are ok with a secrets-provider mock in CI but need the final path to use our HSM-backed KMS (will share Okta/identity and KMS owner info).
- Airgap packaging: for our offline clusters we need tarball bundles of Helm charts + an anchored index.yaml — can your release CI produce an airgap artifact as part of the release job?

Attached is our network diagram with the specific subnet ranges and the on‑prem peering topology.

— Arjun
Arjun Patel
Senior SRE, Acme Corp
(arjun.patel@acme.com)
(attachment: acme-network-diagram.pdf pdf)

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com, Arjun Patel <arjun.patel@acme.com>
Date: 2026-09-21T16:40:00Z
Subject: Re: On‑prem IaC ownership handover — starting the handoff + normalization items

Folks — good thread. I ran the checklist through the compliance lens and added a short CI gating proposal inline below. Quoted for context: 

> "Proposed meeting: Tue 22 Sep... target: 2026‑10‑15 cutover."

CI gating proposal (must be green for canary promotion):
- merge_request pipeline: lint + unit (helm lint, terraform validate, ansible-lint) — required
- bootstrap-smoke job: runs in a lightweight environment (fast, <10m) — required
- integration job: k8s integration tests + network e2e (can be optional for small fixes)
- audit evidence job: auto-generate a tarball of the plan outputs + a provenance manifest and upload to the evidence bucket whenever network/bgp/egress changes occur — required for our SOC2 evidence set

Operational notes:
- Add a label workflow: "privinfra/maintenance" that triggers the blackout window check in the MR checklist; the merge bot should block merges into main if that label is present and the window is outside an approved schedule.
- For airgap bundles: add a "release/airgap" artifact profile in the release job. Ensure Helm chart indices are sha256 pinned and include manifest.json with all artifact checksums.

I will attach the compliance checklist as part of the calendar prep — we need one person from Acme (Arjun?) to sign off on the blackout window policy and confirm the KMS owner path.

Irene Choi
Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
(attachment: ci-gating-checklist.xlsx spreadsheet)

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>

- Decisions made: collapse edge-provisioners + bastion-scripts into network-bootstrap module; implement secrets/lookup ansible role; add bootstrap-smoke job; add "release/airgap" profile for Helm artifacts.
- Action owners: Karthik will author the bootstrap-smoke job template (MR 4123) — ETA 2026‑09‑27. Irene will add the audit evidence job and label gating — ETA 2026‑09‑28. Priyom will update the module README and publish the interface contract diff.
- Acme asks: Arjun to confirm blackout windows + KMS owner info by 2026‑09‑24 so we can include it in the cutover runbook.

I've created the calendar invite for Tue 22 Sep 11:00 PT to walk through the patch and handoff checklist. Agenda: (1) module boundaries & API, (2) CI gating & evidence, (3) airgap release flow, (4) timeline + cutover checklist. If there are changes to the schedule, ping me directly.

Attachments for the followups: priv-iac-normalization-diff.patch, ci-gating-checklist.xlsx

— Priyom
